I am young but I have learned from my father how to grow maize here in Oromia. This small plot of 0.11 hectares near the house is where we put our main maize, so I want to give it good care — I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative if it comes in time, though the amount is never enough. We always put manure from our cattle on this plot because it helps the soil, and I will try to use improved seed since maize gives better harvest with it. I cannot afford pesticide and we have no irrigation, so I depend on the meher rains and my own hands; my younger brother and mother will help me weed.
